deadline.value: Admission is continuous with no fixed deadline, but a PhD position advert may set its own closing date.
deadline.quote: There are no fixed application deadlines for these programmes.

also.quote: The deadlines vary depending upon the individual vacancies

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: The main supervisor must be appointed when you are admitted, so agree a supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: The main supervisor must be appointed at the time the candidate is admitted.

funding.value: Most NTNU PhD candidates are paid research fellows, but funding must be documented before admission.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates at NTNU are employed as PhD research fellows (stipendiat) at NTNU or a university college.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree or equivalent is needed, with a strong academic record; the faculty may approve comparable qualifications.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for the PhD programmes at the Faculty of Natural Sciences must have a relevant master's degree or equivalent education, with a strong academic record.

notes: PHKJ. No department-level fee, GRE or English rule on the programme page.
name: PhD in Chemistry
